breve: An unsigned scalar integer function to be used within the visual shader graph.
descricao: Accept an unsigned integer scalar (x) to the input port and transform it according to 'function'.

propriedades.desc: A function to be applied to the scalar.

constantes.desc: Returns the result of bitwise NOT operation on the integer. Translates to ~a in the Godot Shader Language.
Represents the size of the 'Function' enum.
